# Flower Bloom Studios

> Custom web design and development for home service businesses. Based in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, serving the surrounding parishes, with clients nationwide.

Flower Bloom Studios is a one-person design studio run by Reid Scott. Every site is designed and built from scratch around the individual business, never from a template. The studio specializes in home service companies: plumbers, roofers, HVAC contractors, landscapers, electricians, exterior cleaning companies, and general contractors.

## How the studio works

- **Flat price, quoted up front.** One number before anything starts. Most projects land between $1,000 and $5,000.
- **Live in as little as two weeks**, depending on the size of the site.
- **Fully hands-off.** Design, copywriting, domain, hosting, and launch are all handled.
- **Unlimited revision rounds** until the design is right.
- **24/7 support after launch**, direct from Reid — not a ticket queue.
- **Ongoing maintenance** available to keep the site current.
- **You own everything**: your domain, your hosting, your site.

## Baton Rouge & service area pages

Flower Bloom Studios is based in Baton Rouge and builds for businesses in every part of the city and the surrounding parishes.

- [Web design in Baton Rouge](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-baton-rouge/): The main Baton Rouge page.
- [Service areas](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/service-areas/): Every city and neighborhood served.

Baton Rouge neighborhoods:

- [Mid City](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-mid-city-baton-rouge/): The Government Street corridor and central Baton Rouge.
- [Downtown](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-downtown-baton-rouge/): The riverfront district plus Spanish Town and Beauregard Town.
- [Garden District & Southdowns](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-garden-district-baton-rouge/): Historic streets and the Perkins Road overpass area.
- [Highland & LSU](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-highland-baton-rouge/): South Baton Rouge around the university, Highland Road and Burbank.
- [Sherwood Forest](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-sherwood-forest-baton-rouge/): Established east-side subdivisions along Coursey and Airline.
- [Shenandoah & Millerville](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-shenandoah-baton-rouge/): The fast-growing southeast corner toward the Ascension line.

Nearby cities and parishes: [Prairieville](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-prairieville/), [Gonzales](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-gonzales/), [Denham Springs](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-denham-springs/), [Zachary](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-zachary/), [Baker](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-baker/), [Central](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-central-la/), [Ascension Parish](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-ascension-parish/), and [Livingston Parish](https://flowerbloomstudios.com/web-design-livingston-parish/).
